before: Drawing projection refused shapes with a zero extent axis and read outline width only from a direct line or a theme line that supplied the colour.
after: Drawing projection admits straight lines with one zero extent axis, marks inset outlines, and inherits outline width and alignment from the theme line attribute by attribute.
reason: The change is a read-only projection of existing document XML. It adds no shared state, operations, snapshot fields, or protocol messages, and it does not change saved XML.
